name: Complete a lap of the Draynor Rooftop Course

evidence.note: Complete every obstacle from the starting wall to the final drop.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Land after a complete rooftop lap and see diary credit.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Recover from the fall and complete a fresh lap.

name: Kill a Cave bug in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves

evidence.note: Use the upper cave reachable by the attached rope. Combat XP depends on how the player fights.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Kill a Cave bug while carrying a working light. Confirm diary credit.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Restore light and health before another attempt.

name: Craft a water rune at the Water Altar

evidence.note: Use one rune essence. Rune output is the conservative one-per-essence minimum.

name: Ask Hans how old your account is

evidence.note: Ask the patrolling NPC for your account age around the castle courtyard.

name: Pickpocket a man or woman in Lumbridge

evidence.note: Open the resulting coin pouch for its three coins.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Successfully pickpocket a local man or woman and open the pouch.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Wait out the stun and try again.

name: Chop and burn an oak log in Lumbridge

evidence.note: Light the same log cut at this waypoint in Lumbridge. No held log is used or retained.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Chop the local oak and light the log in Lumbridge before leaving.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Chop another local oak log and retry lighting it in the area.

name: Kill a zombie in the Draynor Sewer

evidence.note: Pick up the ordinary bones after the kill. Combat XP depends on how the player fights.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Kill a Draynor Sewer zombie and pick up its bones.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Heal or change combat supplies before trying again.

name: Net an anchovy in Al Kharid

evidence.note: The spot also yields shrimp. Count the first successful anchovy.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Catch an anchovy at the Al Kharid net spot.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Keep fishing at the net spot until you catch an anchovy.

name: Bake bread on the Lumbridge Castle range

evidence.note: Use bread dough on the castle range after Cook’s Assistant.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Bake an unburned loaf and see diary credit.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Use another bread dough if the first loaf burns.

name: Mine iron at the Al Kharid mine

evidence.note: Collect a successfully mined ore.

name: Enter the H.A.M. Hideout

evidence.note: Pick the trapdoor if closed, then descend. The existing travel edge can register the same task.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Open the trapdoor and reach the hideout.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Retry the lock if it fails, then climb down.

name: Browse Thessalia’s Clothes Shop

evidence.note: Open the shop from the Trade option.

name: Mine iron at the southeast Varrock mine

evidence.note: Collect a successfully mined ore.

name: Pay the Varrock Sawmill to make a plank

evidence.note: Pay the operator to convert an ordinary log into a regular plank.

name: Jump the fence south of Varrock

evidence.note: Cross the fence shortcut and return to the approach for onward travel.

name: Chop down a dying tree at Varrock Sawmill

evidence.note: Cut the dying tree beside the sawmill for an ordinary log.

name: Buy a newspaper from Benny

evidence.note: Use Benny’s purchase dialogue for one newspaper.

name: Give a bone to a Varrock stray dog

evidence.note: The dog patrols nearby. Wait for the dog or follow it locally before using the bone.

name: Make a bowl in Barbarian Village

evidence.note: Shape the bowl on the local wheel and fire it in the neighboring oven. Credit requires both steps in Barbarian Village.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Shape and fire a bowl in the Barbarian Village workshop.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Make another bowl from soft clay if it cracks during firing.

name: Speak to Curator Haig Halen with at least 50 kudos

evidence.note: Use the curator’s dialogue at 50 or more kudos. The separate information-clerk XP claim has its own gate.

name: Craft an earth rune at the Earth Altar

evidence.note: Use one rune essence. Rune output is the conservative one-per-essence minimum.

name: Fly-fish a trout in Barbarian Village

evidence.note: Budget one feather for the successful trout at the River Lum lure spot.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Catch a trout at the Barbarian Village lure spot.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Keep fishing with spare feathers if a salmon is caught first.

name: Steal a cup of tea at the Varrock tea stall

evidence.note: Take one cup when the stall owner and guards do not see the theft.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Steal tea from the Varrock stall and get diary credit.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Wait until the stall restocks and the guards look away.

name: Buy Lumbridge & Draynor Easy diary supplies

evidence.note: Fixed planning price for tradeable diary supplies. Individual prices can vary.

name: Buy Varrock Easy diary supplies

evidence.note: Fixed planning price for tradeable diary supplies. Individual prices can vary.

name: Confirm all tasks for Lumbridge & Draynor Easy Diary

evidence.note: At the taskmaster, record the tier milestone after every registered task.

name: Claim Lumbridge & Draynor Easy Diary rewards

evidence.note: One separate taskmaster handover of the equipment and held antique lamp.

name: Confirm all tasks for Varrock Easy Diary

evidence.note: At the taskmaster, record the tier milestone after every registered task.

name: Claim Varrock Easy Diary rewards

evidence.note: One separate taskmaster handover of the equipment and held antique lamp.

name: Buy Zaff’s Varrock Easy battlestaff stock

evidence.note: The Easy diary unlocks 15 staves at 7,000 each. Share the modeled daily purchase window with the Medium stock.
